name: Muramite Citadel Complex
summary: The fortified heart of Muramite power in Kuua, surrounding the central Citadel.
description: The Muramite Citadel Complex is a heavily fortified region encircling the central Citadel. Outer rings, barracks, sanctum halls, and inner core structures form layered defenses. Legionnaires, officers, and arcane specialists operate here, coordinating warfront efforts across Kuua. Discord energy saturates the area, empowering Muramite forces while destabilizing reality. Resistance agents rarely reach this region, and those who do face overwhelming odds.
